_comment: Fleet environments registry — synced from the AgentArmyPowerTemplate hub to every spoke under .agent/environments.json. A sandboxed spoke agent (microVM with no hub board access) reads this to discover where every other layer lives at runtime. DO NOT edit in a spoke — the next hub sync overwrites it. Update on the hub, the daily fleet-sync routine pushes it out.

local._comment: Native localhost ports per docs/running-locally.md. Use scripts/dev-up.{ps1,sh} to boot in order.

dev._comment: Azure Container Apps managed environment 'cae-arcade-platform' in resource group 'rg-arcade-platform', region eastus. Internal apps are only reachable from inside the same ACA env (middle-core MUST deploy here to call backend-core).

backend_core.notes: Internal-only; middle-core MUST be deployed into cae-arcade-platform to reach this FQDN. allowInsecure=true, transport=Http. /v1 (LLM gateway) routes are flag-gated; /v1/tools/{search,extract} requires TAVILY_API_KEY (resolved via secretref:tavily-api from KV).

arcadedb.notes: Shared graph DB; backend-core is the canonical writer. Reader/root passwords in KV (arcadedb-reader-password / arcadedb-root-password).

middle_core.notes: Not yet deployed in Azure as of 2026-05-26. When deployed, MUST land in cae-arcade-platform to reach backend-core. The agent_runtime (Python FastAPI on :8001) is the primary surface; the .NET MiddleCore is a separate process for ontology/pinning.

prod._comment: Not provisioned as of 2026-05-26. Tracked by hub#219 (rg-aa-env-tier naming) + hub#220 (Front Door + WAF). Will follow the same shape: external front door -> internal-ingress spokes in a hardened ACA env.

consumption_examples._comment: How spokes resolve another layer's URL. Prefer reading from this file at build/deploy time; the literal URLs above belong here, not in code.
consumption_examples.frontend_core_calling_backend: NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_CORE_URL or BACKEND_CORE_URL env var set from environments.json.dev.apps.backend_core.url
consumption_examples.middle_core_calling_backend: BACKEND_CORE_URL env var set from environments.json.dev.apps.backend_core.url; JWT minted using AUTH_JWT_SECRET (HS256 dev) or OIDC (prod)
